notes.title: Zombie Slapper Update 0.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update tackles various bugs that have come up over the last couple of weeks as well as some bugs that have been in the game since release. Check out the patch notes below for full details.

[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
- Increased the overall speed of running zombies as part of the fix for the zombie collision bug fix.

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
- Fixed the long standing zombie collisions bug. Zombies should no longer push the player up and out of the horde or through obstacles.
	[list]
[*] [b]Note:[/b] This change caused zombie pathing to be a little less intelligent, overall though it is much better I think.
[/list]- Fixed the jittery movement of the zombies while they were running.
- Fixed an bug that would not let the player fill up the gas can.
- Fixed a bug that would not reset the damage screen for the player on death with an extra life.
- Fixed a bug that would make base zombies not attack the fences during the defense phase of the easter egg.
- Made it so the super zombies that spawn after the church phase of the easter egg will reset and respawn if a player dies with an extra life.
- Fixed an issue that would cause the camera to go through the outer walls of the map.
- Fixed a bug that could cause the player to float inside of the church, that one probably wasn't caused by the angry zombie spirits you keep burning...
- Fixed an issue that would allow zombies to pass through the fences around the relay tower.
- Fixed a placement issue for the Orb of Flame after beating the Easter Egg Boss Fight.

notes.title: Update 0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Zombie Slapper Update 0.2 Patch Notes 1/21/23[/b]

This update introduces a new Custom Operations mode as well some quality of life updates and bug fixes. The update is approximately 29mb in size. Check out the patch notes below for full details.

[b]<New Features>[/b]

- Added a custom operation feature that can be accessed from the "Select Operation" menu. In this menu you can edit 20+ different parameters for the game to your liking. Note that all progression is blocked during custom operations.
- Along with custom games, a few preset game modes have been added too:
[list]
[*] "One Slap Chap" makes all zombies one hit, but also makes you one hit.
[*] "Pain" increases the difficulty of the game significantly. Player base stats, stat point earnings, power-up times, and earned money are all reduced by 50%. Zombie kill EXP and round completion EXP is increased by 50% in this game mode.
[*] "It's a Feature" causes random things to happen every 60 seconds. There are 30 different events that can happen that range from earning money, to changing zombie behavior, or even just changing random settings in the game. 
[/list] 
[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
- Slowed down the Helislaptor animation slightly but also made the ultimate last sightly longer.
- Changed the way that traps calculate damage. Previously traps would instant kill base zombies no matter what and it would do 1.5x the amount of slap damage that you do to super zombies. Now traps calculate damage the same way that player slaps calculate damage with a 1.5x multiplier to all zombie types. This means in the later rounds that base zombies will not always be one hit, but it also means that traps can now crit. This should result in overall trap effectiveness increasing.

[b]<Quality of Life>
[/b]
- Added an indicator that tells you the name of a power-up when its used. 
- Added a red outline around the screen that gets darker as your health gets lower as well as a heartbeat sound that gets louder as your health gets lower to better indicate that you are taking damage. The outline is not there and the sound does not play when your health is full.
- Changed health regen to be 20% of your max health/second instead of 20 health/second to avoid long health regens after upgrading your health in later rounds. With health regen power up its 25% health/second.
- Added a new text box in the pause menu that shows what perk cards you have active.
- Added an option in the settings menu to hide the armor skin when armor is active.
- Added the skip cutscene option to the opening cutscene of the game.
- Added a new interactable in the starting area that allows you to turn on/off "aggressive zombies". This makes the zombies spawn at the fastest spawn speed and they are always runners with a faster initial speed. All other scaling remains unchanged.
- Updated stat point station UI to show what the next bonus will be rather than the current bonus as well as making it more clearly indicated as to what the purchase requirements are.
- Added a sound effect as well as a flashing animation to the ultimate bar when your ultimate is ready.

[b]<Clean Up>[/b]

- Added various sound effects across the game.
- Updated the fire effect in the fire barrels to match the fire effect in the rest of the game.
- Changed the run animation to scale with the speed of your character.
- Performed more script optimizations.
- Updated the dash ability icon from the old player model to the current one.
- Made the Belly Boi animations blend properly.

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]

- Fixed the distortion that would happen when killing a zombie with higher level damage.
- Fixed a pathing issue at the gas station that would cause zombies to get stuck on the pump.
- Fixed bug that would allow you to damage the "Nun-Dead" boss with a slap while her shield was up.
- Fixed an issue that wouldn't show the stat bonuses in the pause menu after opening the help and settings menu.
- Fixed an issue at the gas station that would cause the player to float for a bit after going over the cracked ground.
- Fixed a visual issue that wouldn't properly update the health bar with the leech perk health recharge.
- Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the zombies to spawn in the wrong area.

notes.title: Zombie Slapper Update 0.1
notes.content:
This update adds a boss fight, quality of life changes, bug fixes, optimization, and more! This update is roughly 66mb in size and sets the framework for the future of the game. Check out the patch notes below for full details!

[b]<New Features>[/b]
- Added an Easter Egg boss fight to the current map. This will take multiple obscure steps to complete and there is no real description on how to do it however when you successfully complete a step a notification sound will play. After completing all steps a boss encounter will happen and if you beat the boss you complete the Easter Egg. I will release a guide separate from the game at a later date but for now I would like to see who can figure it out with out a guide.
- Added a small amount of back story to the game. As of now it only consists of a map description at the main menu as well as some cutscenes when you reach the boss encounter. I plan on adding more in future updates in the form of collectables that are placed throughout the map.
- Added an animation when you start the game at main menu as well as when you load into the selected map.
- Added a loading screen between the Main Menu and the map instead of just having the game come to a stand still.
- Added 3 new secret achievements associated with the new Easter Egg.
- Introduced "Permanent Buffs", when you beat this boss encounter you unlock a permanent buff that you will get the bonuses from any time you play the game and will persist through all future maps. When I add more maps and boss fights in the future they will also come with permanent buffs but for now there is only one that is unlockable.

[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
- Changed the name of "Bounty Hunter Hat" to "The Chorito".
- Moved the power-up station in front of the church over to the helipad in the military checkpoint.
- Made various minor adjustments to the map, definitely has nothing to do with the easter egg.....
- Changed the look of trap kill zones and made them a little more accurate to where the kill zone is.
- Changed the hit box on the Slapapult trap, it was originally way larger than intended resulting in zombies being killed far away from the trap.
- Increased the speed at which you can use the base slap attack.
- Greatly reduced how often the slow down time effect activates while using the all crit power up.
- Replaced the "Start Game" button with an "Select Operation" button that will pull up a new menu from which you can choose a map you would like to play. There is still only one map, but this is setting up the framework for future ones.

[b]<Optimization>[/b]
- Performed some backend adjustments to help the game run smoother and should result in less CPU usage overall. Almost every single script in the game received adjustments and, while I did quite a bit of testing myself, this may result in various bugs throughout the game.

[b]<Quality of Life>[/b]
- Updated the mini-map to show the actual map objects instead of just cubes. Also updated all of the minimap icons to look a little more clean.
- Updated the buy menu with a small description for each item if you can't purchase it for any reason other than not enough currency. Also added an indicator for how many extra lives you can purchase per game in the buy menu.

[b]<Clean-Up>[/b]
- Changed the overall look of the fire effect that appears with the zombie fire power-up. It now also doesn't stay on the ground when you kill the zombies.
- Removed the bars that showed how much time was left in a power-up and replaced it with a countdown text instead.
- Balanced the audio across the game to all be on relatively the same level. This results in everything being overall quieter, would love feedback especially on this. I will also be doing more audio work in the next patch.
- Corrected a couple of text errors through the game.

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
- Fixed a progress tracking issue for the In for the Long Game challenge and retroactively added progress to the challenge.
- Fixed a visual issue for the UltiGen Power-Up timer that would cause the timer to not reset if a second UltiGen Power-Up was picked up while one was currently active.
- Fixed a backend issue with steam that would occasionally cause player level tracking to be disabled at the main menu upon first loading into the game.
- Fixed an exploit that would allow you to activate a trap multiple times while only having to arm it once.
- Fixed a bug that would show all player hair when wearing a hat instead of the preset one for the hats.
- Fixed an issue that would make the mouse cursor disappear if you exited the pause menu while a buy station was active.
- Fixed an issue that would prevent the wave start countdown from counting down properly altering an extra life round reset.

notes.title: Zombie Slapper Version 0.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Version 0.0.1 fixes the zombie stacking and physics issues and also adds a couple of QoL changes. Full patch notes below.

<Quality of Life>

* Set up the framework for Cloud Saving on Steam. I will need to do some testing with this update before making the Cloud Saving public but it should be available soon.
* The game now auto pauses when a controller disconnects mid-game as well as when the game window is no longer the main focus (e.g. hitting windows button or opening steam console).
* If you buy and ultimate change and don't change your ultimate, the cost of the ultimate change will now be refunded.

<Game Fixes>

* Zombie collisions and avoidance now work as intended. Zombies no longer stack or push the player out of the horde.
* Fixed a couple of text issues.
